summary: P2 (standards; probed): DRY_RUN_SETTING requires `set` to be followed directly by `dry-run`, so the I12b route `npm config set dry-run` passes as soon as it carries an option or an alias: `npm config set -g dry-run true`, `npm config set --location=user dry-run true`, `npm config --global set dry-run true`, `npm c set dry-run true` all pass and would turn the whole publish job (and `npm install -g npm@...`) into a dry run on a tag push, the green-but-unpublished release I11 exists to stop. Fix: match `npm` + (`config`|`c`) + any options + `set` + any options + `dry[-_]run` within one command (or reuse the whoami word scanner). An `.npmrc` write of `dry-run=true` also passes [not enumerated in I12b].
